note: Fictional scenario configuration. Durations are simulation seconds.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Keep at least two of the three original command posts operational for 10 minutes.

skies.name: Contested Skies
skies.description: Patrol three airspace sectors. Reach 360 control points, or lead at the deadline.

campaign.name: Command Campaign
campaign.description: Discover and disable all three original opposing command posts. Preserve one of yours.

armor.name: Desert Spear
armor.description: Capture the three desert sectors with ground forces and hold them together for 45 seconds.

seacontrol.name: Ocean Sentinel
seacontrol.description: Control three Arabian Sea sectors with warships. Reach 300 points, or lead at the deadline.

convoy.name: Supply Corridor
convoy.description: Escort at least two of the three marked supply columns to the southern rally zone.

harborwatch.name: Harbor Watch
harborwatch.description: Sail both marked replenishment ships into the offshore rendezvous zone. Keep both alive.

runway.name: Runway Denial
runway.description: Locate and disable three designated fictional opposing airfields. Keep a command post operational.

missileraid.name: Distant Thunder
missileraid.description: Scout and disable the two marked fictional military installations. Cruise batteries require manual launch orders.

economy.name: Iron Economy
economy.description: Earn 2,000 credits during the round and complete two resource works plus one additional command base.

recon.name: Night Watch
recon.description: Identify all three marked enemy military sites under reduced night visibility. Keep a command post alive.

monsoon.name: Monsoon Shield
monsoon.description: Preserve two original command posts through ten minutes of reduced visibility and slower air movement.

laststand.name: Last Light
laststand.description: One command post remains. Hold it for eight minutes against six increasingly strong waves.

joint.name: Three Fronts
joint.description: Hold two land sectors, disable two marked enemy airfields, and retain at least one warship.

sandbox.name: Open Command
sandbox.description: Build an army, expand your bases, and control land, air and sea. End the exercise when you choose.
